newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-NAPOLI COACH QUITS OVER CONTRACTS ROW.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NAPOLI COACH QUITS OVER CONTRACTS ROW.

text.p: Napoli coach Gigi Simoni said on Wednesday he was quitting the Italian Serie A club because of a row over contracts.
"I asked for a two-year contract but they only wanted to renew me for one year. That's why I'm going," Simoni told reporters.
"The club did all it could to keep me and I also pushed in the same direction. But we couldn't agree on this point. It wasn't a question of money."
Napoli are currently 13th in the league table.
